shots.qa: Six sampled frames: slow doorway push into stable attic. Door begins open; readable POV entry, no character visible.
Six sampled frames: stable Luna and attic. Her foot nudges the shoebox into foreground; the box travels farther than a subtle nudge, but motion is readable. No face close-up.

Six sampled frames: exactly two shoes stay in the open box; one photo is picked up with a natural hand. Shoe wear stable. Photo details are small; readable R.M. and photo-back lettering still require the shared editorial treatment.
Six sampled frames: lace pull and natural shoe step; no extra limbs. Cream wear/repair marks differ subtly from final macro, as in shared anchors.
Six sampled frames: stable shoes, clean sole landing and camera rise. First3s usable; younger shoe has plain outer side and no cream repair.
Six sampled frames: natural gather, jump and offscreen shot; ball exits upper frame. Use first3.5s. Follows visible hoop at left only as background, not basket result.
Six sampled frames: single ball drops through hoop/net and exits. Use0.25–1.75s to include result within1.5s slot.
Six sampled frames: stable face and progressive pleased smile. Use source2.0–4.0s for the smile payoff.
Six sampled frames: black/red sneakers remain separate and coherent; compact toe tap and salsa footwork. No morph transition is baked in; cut matches previous shoe shot.

Six sampled frames: stable couple, hand invitation, hand contact and a small synchronized dance step. Full8s usable; faces and black/red shoes remain coherent. Dance is deliberately restrained rather than big choreography.
Six sampled frames: newlyweds exchange smiles with stable faces, clothes and period street. Wide-to-closer drift rather than literal shoe-to-face tilt.
Six sampled frames: securely held single newborn and affectionate parents. Baby/finger contact remains small in frame; no detailed hand macro.

Six sampled frames: clear offer, shoe lowered to daughter's foot, father kneels and tends the laces, then shared smile. One shoe remains on daughter and one sock visible; good emotional continuity over8s.
Six sampled frames: stable Luna face and restrained look toward doorway, slight natural lip movement late. First3s usable.
Six sampled frames: Luna returns one photo to the box, turns toward doorway and smiles. Mouth is small/profile; exact dialogue sync is not guaranteed.
Six sampled frames: stable mother face, smile appears at2.4s. Use source2.0–4.0s for final reaction.

Six sampled frames: one short step then stable ending hold, with clear left-side negative space for title. Plain outer side remains coherent and far inner badge is visible. Small cream repair is partly occluded by motion.
